The '''''Haven''-class medical station''', more commonly known as the '''Republic medical station''', was a model of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Twenty in all were commissioned for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], one for each of its [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]]. They were each capable of treating nearly 80,000 patients.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Kaliida_Shoals.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] docking at a Republic medical station]]
The typical station had a reactor slung underneath, port entrances for [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class medical frigates]], and eight main medical bays. The stations were highly vulnerable and were dependent on other spacecraft to aid in fending off attackers.<ref name="db">{{DB|location|kaliidashoals|Kaliida Shoals Med Center}}</ref>

==History==
These stations served as a lifeline for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], being placed near battlefields to service groups of medical frigates bringing in the wounded. The first such station, the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], was created near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]].<ref name="SOM">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The Republic then commissioned nineteen more stations, one each for its twenty [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]].<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles" /> Besides the Kaliida Shoals Medcenter, stations were established in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]]<ref name="BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> and near [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].<ref name="BI">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>
